reviewed_interpretation: The single authoritative I029 execution is valid and fully covered: 126 donor cases and 126 target cases were evaluated, all donor cases reached the fixed first-ready eight-reference snapshot, every noise domain had 18 ready donors, target benchmark coverage and matched/negative donor coverage were all 1.0, and NS/VAD shipping mirrors were exact. On the preregistered primary population of 69 target cases with at least one pre-ready speech target, the metadata-matched donor had a lower median absolute gap error than the fixed cross-domain negative control (0.066090957 versus 0.210468486), a positive median paired improvement of 0.041638762, and was better on 62.32% of non-tied pairs. However the preregistered one-sided paired sign-test was p=0.0266446819, above the frozen p<=0.01 support threshold. Therefore the primary directional hypothesis is not supported and I029 selects no reference-source candidate. The secondary concentration metric was stronger (p=0.0077161487), but it was explicitly secondary and must not replace the failed primary gap criterion post hoc. Per-domain descriptive outputs are heterogeneous: living shows a strong gap advantage (median paired improvement 0.23039842775, p=0.0037689209), while bus and field show negative median gap improvement (-0.029482439 and -0.005488776 respectively). Cafeteria remains directionally positive but not decisive. These descriptive differences motivate a fresh stability/residual decomposition, not a donor selection or shipping change.

primary_directional_review.population: target cases with at least one pre-ready speech target

concentration.interpretation: secondary diagnostic only; cannot replace the failed primary gap metric

proposed_followup_hypothesis.rationale: Use entirely fresh, disjoint donor and target public-development seeds while freezing the I029 K=3 matched-donor selection rule and the same cross-domain negative-control map. Do not tune donor matching and do not select a reference source. Preserve the eight joint (mean, concentration, gap) ordinary-noise frames that form each donor and target first-ready reference instead of retaining only independent component medians. Decompose matched-donor transfer error into signed mean/concentration/gap residuals, within-donor and between-donor dispersion, target-reference dispersion, and joint residual alignment. Preregister bus and field as adverse stress domains and living/cafeteria as comparison domains based on I029 descriptive outputs; also report fixed SNR strata without changing matching. The goal is to determine whether the failed primary gap direction is caused by donor-pool instability, component-residual misalignment, or condition-specific transfer, before any donor-rule redesign or candidate test.
required_gates: fresh donor and target seeds disjoint from I025-I029
donor and target identities are seed-bound and disjoint
I029 K=3 metadata-only matched-donor rule frozen unchanged
I029 cross-domain negative-control map frozen unchanged
all first-ready references preserve eight joint per-frame mean/concentration/gap tuples
same-target future frames never enter the donor reference
global and per-domain donor/target coverage reported
prohibited: post-hoc change of matching priority or negative-control map
assumption that development matching metadata is available in shipping

verification_limits: I029 is development-only; its donor selection uses synthetic/development metadata and does not establish that equivalent metadata is available in a shipping product.
The primary gap hypothesis failed its preregistered p<=0.01 support threshold even though medians were directionally favorable; the threshold must not be relaxed after observing the result.
The secondary concentration p-value must not be promoted into a replacement primary endpoint or used to select a donor/reference candidate post hoc.
Per-domain differences are descriptive outputs from I029 and motivate fresh decomposition only; they are not shipping-domain admission decisions.
The target first-ready snapshot is a retrospective benchmark only and never a causal reference for earlier target frames.
No reference-source candidate, component counterfactual, mapping, threshold, tracker change, validation-grade, blind, HIL, product-certification, source-merge or release authority was consumed.
